environment: Isolated native Harness web profile; generated three-page synthetic PDFs; deterministic local test model
checks: opening a paper retains the current main conversation and reuses its own paper conversation
inline send creates a native main-conversation turn and both views show the same completed reply
opening another paper's main conversation restores its inline draft
main-input append targets the correct conversation and preserves existing text; the other paper's draft stays intact
closing and reopening the pane restores an unsaved page-two annotation and its exact text
save-and-draft persists the annotation and appends readable page-two context to the correct native main input
native main-input send appears in the embedded conversation with the completed assistant reply
the embedded save-reply control confirms that the real assistant message was saved into the managed PDF
automatic annotation sending is initially unchecked
reader page two and selected annotation context survive the native session remount
limitations: Native Harness hides blank conversations from its sidebar until their first turn; the plugin can reopen them
No formal user study, real provider quality evaluation, or new memory benchmark
Deliberate fixture-host restarts generated expected reconnect warnings during development
